name: raven-solana-txversion-experimental/0
status: EXPERIMENTAL — Raven R&D demo profile for Crypto World's Fair 2026. Not an accepted Raven protocol, not a certification, not a security audit.
description: Narrow claim: envelope-level admission of serialized Solana transactions. A target claiming this profile must accept wire-valid legacy/v0/v1 transactions and reject malformed, non-canonical, or unsupported-version bytes — purely from offline byte structure. Ed25519 signature verification, account existence, blockhash freshness, simulation, and on-chain execution are OUT OF SCOPE.
scope_out: Account existence, ownership, or balances on any cluster
Current mainnet behavior claims (fixtures are synthetic or locally generated; see PROVENANCE.md)

invocation.input: One JSON object per invocation on stdin: {"tx_base64": "<base64 of serialized transaction bytes>"} — exactly one key.
invocation.output: One JSON object: {"decision":"ACCEPT"|"REJECT","version":"legacy"|0|1|null,"reason":"string"}. version is null iff decision is REJECT.

rules: R1 input_shape: reject malformed_input unless the input is a JSON object with exactly one key, tx_base64, a string.
R2 base64: reject malformed_base64 unless strict RFC 4648 base64 decoding succeeds (alphabet + correct padding + round-trip length).

R3 envelope_version: if decoded[0] === 0x81 the transaction is v1 (version byte at offset zero, SIMD-0385). If decoded[0] >= 0x80 and != 0x81 reject unsupported_version (0x80 reserved at offset zero; 0x82..0xFF = versions 2..127 not supported). A first byte >= 0x80 can never be a canonical short-vec signature count, so no valid legacy/v0 transaction is misclassified.

R4 sigcount_envelope (legacy/v0 family): read the signature count as a short-vec (compact-u16) in CANONICAL minimal encoding; reject non_canonical_shortvec otherwise. Reject truncated if fewer than 64*count signature bytes follow.
R5 message_version (legacy/v0 family): after signatures, message[0] === 0x80 means v0; message[0] with MSB clear means legacy; message[0] MSB set with any other value rejects unsupported_version.

R6 header_consistency (all versions): num_readonly_signed < num_required_signatures (equality is a sanitization failure — it would make the fee payer readonly — so num_required_signatures >= 1 is implied); num_required_signatures <= account_count; (num_required_signatures - num_readonly_signed) + num_readonly_unsigned <= account_count. (Agave message sanitize semantics; SIMD-0385 restates the equality rule for v1.)
R7 signature_count_binding: the transaction's signature vector length must equal header.num_required_signatures exactly. (Profile rule, consistent with runtime sanitize.)

R8 structure (legacy/v0): account keys short-vec (32B each), 32B blockhash, instructions short-vec [program_index u8][accounts short-vec u8][data short-vec u8]; every account index and program index must be < total addressable accounts (static + lookup-table-loaded for v0). v0 only: lookup-table short-vec follows instructions [32B table address][writable indexes short-vec][readonly indexes short-vec]. Legacy has no lookup section.

R9 structure (v1, GROUPED layout per SIMD-0385 proposal text, confirmed against @solana/kit 8.3.0 encoder output): version(0x81) | legacyHeader(3) | configMask u32 LE | lifetimeSpecifier(32) | numInstructions u8 | numAddresses u8 | addresses[N*32] | configValues | InstructionHeaders[numInstructions x (programAccountIndex u8, numInstructionAccounts u8, numInstructionDataBytes u16 LE)] | InstructionPayloads[numInstructions x (accountIndexes[numInstructionAccounts] ++ instructionData[numInstructionDataBytes])] | signature tail of exactly header.num_required_signatures x 64 raw bytes (no short-vec count — count implicit). ALL InstructionHeaders come first, THEN ALL InstructionPayloads concatenated; the interleaved header-then-payload-per-instruction shape is NOT v1. configMask bits: 0b11 = priorityFeeLamports (u64, both bits must be set together), 0b100 = computeUnitLimit (u32), 0b1000 = loadedAccountsDataSizeLimit (u32), 0b10000 = heapSize (u32); values positional in that field order. Reject config_mask_invalid on partial fee bits (mask & 3 == 1 or 2) or any unknown bit above 0b10000. v1 rejects duplicate static accounts (SIMD-0385: 'It is a sanitization failure for this array to contain any duplicates'). v1 has NO address lookup tables.
R10 heap_bounds: a present v1 heapSize must be a multiple of 1024 in [32768, 262144]; reject config_heap_out_of_range otherwise (Solana docs: out-of-range heap is a sanitization failure).
R11 exact_consumption: parsing must consume every byte exactly; reject trailing_bytes or truncated.
R12 size_caps: legacy/v0 total <= 1232 bytes; v1 total <= 4096 bytes (Solana docs version matrix; SIMD-0385 transaction constraints).

R12b v1_count_caps (v1 only): num_required_signatures <= 12, num_addresses <= 64, num_instructions <= 64 (SIMD-0385 Transaction Constraints table). For legacy/v0 these caps are already implied by the 1232-byte size cap and need no separate check.
R13 ACCEPT only when all applicable rules pass, reporting the detected version; REJECT otherwise with version null.

claimed_conformance_meaning: A target claiming this profile must match corpus expected decision AND version exactly on every vector. CONFORMANT on this corpus means: matched this named corpus at its pinned digest on these byte-level rules. It does not establish external-spec conformance, signature validity, or on-chain behavior.
